This template is the framework for each of the chapter lists on the book and chapter summary pages. This template contains the code for the top section book links, template collapse, prologue and epilogue placement, and chapter lists. Changes to this template will affect each of the fifteen chapter list templates. As this template is a framework, no page should use this template. One of the following templates should be used instead: [[:Template:Infobox chapters ns|NS]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 1|1]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 2|2]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 3|3]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 4|4]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 5|5]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 6|6]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 7|7]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 8|8]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 9|9]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 10|10]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 11|11]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 12|12]], [[:Template:Infobox chapters 13|13]], or [[:Template:Infobox chapters 14|14]].
